issues.description: The UML and problem description declare getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a public method, but the solution implementation declares it as protected. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended API and may cause access issues if tests or example usage expect a public method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getTotalNumberOfStudents() method public in the solution (and document it as public in the template) so it matches the UML/problem statement. Alternatively, update the UML/problem text to intentionally indicate the method should be protected if that is desired, and ensure all references/tests reflect that visibility.
